inputs.checklistItemText: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible
inputs.question: Are there any trees shown on the landscape plan or site plan near any of the transformer pads? If so, what species are shown and what are the distances from the transformer pads?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence and identification check (locating trees near pads and reading their labeled species), not yet measuring clearance distances. The measurement of lateral distances will follow once trees are identified.
